optimization.emptyDescription: Recommendations appear after you add a title or content.

optimization.methodologyDescription: Each check is weighted by importance. A passed check earns full credit, a recommendation earns half, and an error earns none. The overall score is the average of the evaluated categories.
optimization.methodologySeoCaps: The SEO score is also capped when the article lacks enough text or a title, or contains an extra H1 or a broken heading hierarchy.

title-exists.title: The article has no title
title-exists.description: Without a title, search engines and readers cannot clearly identify the article topic.
title-exists.recommendation: Add a specific title that clearly names the article's main topic.

title-length.title: The title is outside the recommended length
title-length.description: A short title may be vague, while a long title can be truncated in search results.
title-length.recommendation: Keep the title between 30 and 65 characters while preserving the main topic.

excerpt-exists.title: The article has no excerpt
excerpt-exists.description: Topiqu uses the excerpt as the meta description in search results.
excerpt-exists.recommendation: Add a concise summary that explains the article's value and encourages readers to open it.

excerpt-length.title: The excerpt is outside the recommended length
excerpt-length.description: A short excerpt lacks context, while a long one can be truncated in search results.
excerpt-length.recommendation: Keep the excerpt between 70 and 160 characters.

single-h1.title: The body contains another main heading
single-h1.description: The page title already acts as H1. Another H1 in the body creates an unclear document structure.
single-h1.recommendation: Change every H1 inside the article body to H2 or a lower level.

heading-hierarchy.title: Headings use an invalid hierarchy
heading-hierarchy.description: The body does not start at H2, or a heading skips a level.
heading-hierarchy.recommendation: Start at H2 and continue without jumps, for example H2, H3, then back to H2.

internal-link.title: The article has no internal link
internal-link.description: The body does not link to another page on the same website.
internal-link.recommendation: Link a relevant phrase to a related article or page on your website.

external-link.title: The article has no external link
external-link.description: The body does not link to an independent source or useful supporting material.
external-link.recommendation: Add a link to a trustworthy relevant source when one supports the claim.

featured-image.title: The article has no featured image
featured-image.description: The article has no image for listings, sharing previews, and the top of the page.
featured-image.recommendation: Upload or select a relevant featured image.

image-alt.title: An image is missing alternative text
image-alt.description: At least one body image has no description for screen readers and search engines.
image-alt.recommendation: Add concise alt text describing the image's meaning in the article.

paragraph-length.title: A paragraph is too long
paragraph-length.description: At least one paragraph exceeds 120 words and is harder to read on a screen.
paragraph-length.recommendation: Split the long paragraph into shorter units, each focused on one idea.

sentence-length.title: The article has too many long sentences
sentence-length.description: More than 10% of sentences exceed 35 words, reducing readability.
sentence-length.recommendation: Split the most complex sentences and keep one main idea in each.

section-length.title: A section is too long
section-length.description: A continuous section without a subheading exceeds 300 words.
section-length.recommendation: Split the section with a descriptive H2 or H3 heading.

long-article-structure.title: The long article needs clearer structure
long-article-structure.description: An article over 250 words does not contain at least two paragraphs and two section headings.
long-article-structure.recommendation: Organize the content into at least two topic sections with their own headings.

topic-introduction.title: The introduction does not establish the topic
topic-introduction.description: The first 120 words contain fewer than half of the meaningful words from the title.
topic-introduction.recommendation: Name the main topic and the article's value directly in the opening paragraphs.

descriptive-sections.title: Descriptive section headings are missing
descriptive-sections.description: The longer article has fewer than two headings that help readers understand its structure.
descriptive-sections.recommendation: Add at least two specific headings describing what each following section covers.

heading-quality.title: A heading is too generic
heading-quality.description: A heading is empty or uses only a generic label such as Introduction, Summary, or Conclusion.
heading-quality.recommendation: Replace the generic label with a specific point readers will learn in that section.

multiple-blocks.title: The content is a single block
multiple-blocks.description: The article is not divided into separate content blocks and is difficult to scan.
multiple-blocks.recommendation: Split the text into multiple paragraphs and add relevant section headings where useful.

sources-exist.title: The article has no recorded source
sources-exist.description: The source list contains no link supporting the article's factual claims.
sources-exist.recommendation: Add at least one trustworthy source used to prepare the article.

sources-valid.title: A source has an invalid address
sources-valid.description: At least one source is not a complete web address starting with http:// or https://.
sources-valid.recommendation: Correct the incomplete address in the source list or remove the invalid entry.

external-links-safe.title: The body contains an invalid or unsafe link
external-links-safe.description: At least one external link lacks a valid HTTP(S) address or uses a disallowed protocol.
external-links-safe.recommendation: Change the destination to a valid https:// URL or remove the link.

source-diversity.title: The long article relies on one website
source-diversity.description: An article of 800 words or more uses fewer than two unique source domains.
source-diversity.recommendation: Add a relevant source from another independent domain.
